inputs.original_text:
Look at what is happening to our great nation right now. We are watching the total collapse of basic law and order in our cities, and it is happening because of reckless progressive sanctuary policies that spit in the face of our communities and our families. 

The Department of Homeland Security just announced the arrest of an illegal immigrant gang member by ICE after he was released by New York City authorities despite posing a danger to public safety. This is what happens when left-wing politicians choose their radical sanctuary agendas over the safety of the citizens they swore to protect. Instead of upholding the rule of law and defending our borders, these sanctuary cities are actively harboring dangerous criminals with criminal records right back onto our streets. 

DHS is entirely right to call out New York City for these reckless actions. It is past time to restore basic authority, put public safety first, and demand real accountability instead of coddling criminals at the expense of everyday citizens who just want to live in peace and safety.
inputs.modified_text:
Folks, what we are witnessing right now is a complete breakdown of basic law and order in our cities, driven entirely by the reckless sanctuary policies pushed by the left. These people are spitting in the face of our communities and our hard-working families just to advance their radical agenda. 

Look at the hard facts: the Department of Homeland Security just announced the arrest of an illegal immigrant gang member by ICE after he was released by New York City authorities, even though he posed a clear danger to public safety. This is the bitter fruit of left-wing politicians choosing their sanctuary ideology over the safety of the citizens they swore to protect. Instead of upholding the rule of law and defending our borders, these sanctuary cities are actively harboring dangerous criminals with criminal records right back onto our streets. 

DHS is entirely right to call out New York City for these reckless actions. It is past time to restore basic authority, put public safety first, and demand real accountability instead of coddling criminals at the expense of everyday citizens who just want to live in peace and safety.
